display.summary: Third 1.16 beta, with the fixes from a stress run of 1.16.0b2. Large OCR backfills finish instead of giving files up, a backup or restore whose worker dies fails at once, restores keep exact timestamps, restore refuses an altered incremental chain, and with ScanLink 0.8.0 a website scans only after the operator allows it. A 1.16.0b1 or b2 deployment updates inline; from 1.15.x, follow the 1.16.0b1 upgrade path.
highlights: OCR: a busy engine no longer uses up a file's retries, so large backfills finish instead of giving files up.
Backups: a backup or restore whose worker dies fails at once instead of blocking new backups; restores keep exact timestamps.
Security: restore refuses an incremental backup whose readable header was altered to disagree with its encrypted contents.
ScanLink 0.8.0: a website scans only after the operator allows it once; System Settings lists the other websites that may scan.
Scanning waits past ScanLink's own deadline and shows ScanLink's error codes translated.
The DLB viewer gets 11 fixes, among them a page token, bounded frame lengths and exact large primary keys.
From 1.16.0b1 or b2 this beta installs inline. From 1.15.x: image on 1.16, ./start.sh check --fix with Composer 1.10+, recreate.
